paragraph:
The price of another tomorrow
A fictional longevity hotel discovers that hope is easier to package than evidence

At the Aster, a fictional hotel in the hills of Belloria, breakfast arrives with a promise of renewal. An (iridescent) drink contains an undisclosed (ingredient); a tablet records each guest's preferred (nutrient). Through the windows, the swimming pool looks (refulgent) in the morning sun. The rates are less restorative.

The proprietor is a (flamboyant) entrepreneur with an engineering (bent) and an (unrepentant) enthusiasm for expensive experiments. He wants to turn a former (convalescent) home into the centre of a (nascent) longevity industry. Investors remain (buoyant). A business selling extra years need only persuade customers that the next breakthrough is close enough to book.

The building supplies an impressive (antecedent) to this new ambition. Its founder was physician to a (regent), whose portrait survives among the few (extant) furnishings. A brass (sextant) suggests scientific adventure; nobody explains its relevance to ageing. The main staircase makes a (magnificent) setting for a slow (descent). For the less mobile, the lift is a more consequential innovation.

At dinner, the room is (resplendent) with silver, its (pendent) lamps casting an (effulgent) glow. A pianist plays a (plangent) melody while guests discuss cellular renewal. The atmosphere is (redolent) of an ocean liner, although the destination is more uncertain. The hotel's most reliable achievement is to make waiting feel like travel.

Its clientele resists a single description. One (resident) is a (corpulent) former industrialist; another an (ardent) marathon runner. A (diffident) widow hopes to regain confidence, while a (despondent) executive wants relief from exhaustion. A (reticent) retired scientist merely enjoys the walking paths. They have bought the same package, but hardly the same product.

That distinction matters. A pleasant stay, an improvement in fitness and a longer life are not (equivalent) outcomes. A (recipient) of attentive care may feel better without demonstrating the hotel's grander claims. The most (salient) question is what has changed, compared with what would otherwise have happened. Luxury makes that comparison unusually difficult.

The medical director is (proficient) and plainly (cognizant) of these problems. He refuses to play the (omniscient) (savant), much to the marketing department's disappointment. A convincing account of benefits needs a (cogent) argument and suitable evidence, not a supposedly (clairvoyant) forecast of each visitor's final birthday.

In a laboratory (adjacent) to the spa, a technician labels a (reagent). Beyond the glass, a (fluorescent) tube flickers; in an older lamp, a broken (filament) awaits replacement. The equipment looks sophisticated, but some machines are already (obsolescent). A polished room is an awkward substitute for a published explanation of what its measurements mean.

The hotel's software tries to (orient) guests towards healthier routines. Yet its interface speaks as if it were (sentient), while remaining an (insentient) system responding to inputs. Calling its advice (sapient) does not establish its reliability. A bracelet that detects movement cannot distinguish an (indolent) afternoon from necessary rest without further context.

One guest is (recumbent) after a long journey; another is (somnolent) after lunch. A third leaves the programme to watch a tennis (tournament), becoming a cheerful (truant) from compulsory relaxation. The dashboard marks all three as insufficiently active. This is an (incogitant) design choice disguised as scientific precision.

The sales brochure is less cautious. It links an (incipient) change in a laboratory measure with sweeping rejuvenation, presenting a (concomitant) improvement in mood as if it settled the matter. Neither a (transient) sensation nor an (evanescent) burst of energy proves lasting benefit. A persuasive graph can still carry an unpersuasive inference.

There is a (piquant) irony here. Customers who have made fortunes questioning suppliers become unusually trusting when the supplier promises youth. An (adolescent) fantasy of limitless possibility returns beneath expensive tailoring. Renewal becomes a (sacrament), and the search for a (transcendent) experience weakens the ordinary habit of asking for a receipt.

Some offerings need no such mythology. A chef can make an (astringent) salad dressing, a gardener can remove a (pestilent) infestation, and a therapist can offer an (emollient) lotion without claiming to defeat time. The herb garden's (pungent) smells may please one visitor and seem (repellent) to another. Preference is not pathology.

The proprietor's intentions may be (benevolent), but good intentions do not settle incentives. An (opulent) retreat earns more from repeated dependence than from telling a guest that nothing further is needed. A (provident) customer keeps savings for ordinary care; an (improvident) one spends them chasing a promise. The (indigent), meanwhile, receive little beyond inspirational publicity.

The town council has its own (predicament). The hotel creates jobs and gives a previously (quiescent) local economy a (renascent) confidence. Councillors are (ambivalent) about restricting it. Their enthusiasm, however, should be (contingent) on honest claims. Employment is not a licence to blur the boundary between hospitality and treatment.

A (dissident) investor has begun asking for clearer disclosures. An (insurgent) group of former guests demands refunds. Their interests are (divergent), yet their demands for transparency are (convergent). Management calls the complaints (strident); a particularly (truculent) spokesman accuses the critics of harbouring (maleficent) intentions. Neither adjective answers a question.

The argument becomes (turbulent) when a (correspondent) publishes an investigation. One survey (respondent) alleges pressure to buy additional sessions. Online commentary turns (virulent), and anonymous posts describe the entire enterprise as (fraudulent). Such an accusation needs evidence of deception. Equally, calling every critic malicious is no substitute for answering documented complaints.

The council must avoid both a (precipitant) ban and indulgent delay. A (prudent) response would distinguish unsupported advertising from demonstrable misconduct. It would be (imprudent) to endorse the business merely because its lobby looks reassuring. Oversight should be (stringent) about claims without treating every uncertain result as wrongdoing.

This balance is politically awkward. An (intransigent) proprietor objects to outside review; an (exigent) public wants immediate certainty. A (lenient) settlement may seem (expedient) before an election and prove (inexpedient) afterwards. One councillor offers a sharp observation: promises grow faster than the budget available to investigate them.

Even the paperwork exposes priorities. Designers carefully (indent) the brochure's testimonials while hiding qualifications in faint type. A supposedly (impudent) question about adverse experiences receives a beautifully worded non-answer. The medical director proposes a plainspoken rewrite; the chairman prefers a soothing phrase. Candour is an uncomfortable amenity to market.

A better Aster would sell what it can credibly provide: comfort, attention and a setting in which ordinary habits become easier. The (constant) challenge is to remain honest when customers want miracles. Building a (resilient) business around that modest offer may yield less excitement than promising a (distant) future without decline. It would also make the present bill easier to defend.
translation:
再多一个明天的价格
一家虚构的长寿酒店发现，希望比证据更容易包装

在贝洛里亚山间一家名叫阿斯特的虚构酒店里，早餐伴随着焕新生命的承诺一同送达。一杯(泛着虹彩的)饮品含有某种未公开的(成分)；平板电脑记录着每位客人偏好的(营养素)。透过窗户，泳池在晨光中显得(熠熠生辉)。房价却没那么让人恢复元气。

酒店主人是一位(张扬的)企业家，有着工程方面的(天赋倾向)，对昂贵实验的热情始终(不知悔改)。他想把昔日的(康复期病人)疗养院改造成一个(新兴的)长寿产业中心。投资者依然(乐观)。一家出售额外寿命的企业，只需让顾客相信，下一次突破已经近到值得预订。

这座建筑为新抱负提供了令人印象深刻的(历史前身)。其创办人曾是一位(摄政者)的医生，后者的肖像仍留在少数(现存的)陈设之中。一具黄铜(六分仪)令人联想到科学探险，却没人解释它与衰老有何关系。主楼梯为缓缓(下行)提供了(壮丽的)背景。对于行动不便者，电梯是更有意义的创新。

晚餐时，餐厅因银器而显得(金碧辉煌)，(悬垂的)灯具洒下(灿烂的)光芒。钢琴师弹奏着(哀婉的)旋律，客人们则讨论细胞更新。这里的气氛(令人联想到)远洋客轮，只不过目的地更加不确定。酒店最可靠的成就，是让等待感觉像旅行。

这里的顾客很难用单一描述概括。一位(住客)是(肥胖的)前工业家，另一位则是(热衷的)马拉松跑者。一位(缺乏自信的)寡妇希望重新找回信心，一名(沮丧的)高管想摆脱疲惫。一位(沉默寡言的)退休科学家，只是喜欢这里的步道。他们买了同一个套餐，却很难说买的是同一种产品。

这种区别很重要。愉快的住宿、体能改善和寿命延长，并非(等同的)结果。悉心照料的(接受者)可能感觉更好，却不足以证明酒店那些更宏大的宣称。最(关键的)问题是：与原本可能发生的情况相比，究竟改变了什么？奢华让这种比较变得格外困难。

医疗主管(业务娴熟)，也明显(了解)这些问题。他拒绝扮演(无所不知的)(学者)，令营销部门颇为失望。要令人信服地说明益处，需要(有说服力的)论证和适当证据，而不是自称具有(预知能力的)、能预测每位客人最后一次生日的预言。

在与水疗区(相邻的)实验室里，一名技术员正在给一种(试剂)贴标签。玻璃后方，一根(荧光)灯管闪烁着；一盏旧灯里，断裂的(灯丝)等待更换。设备看起来很先进，但有些机器已经(逐渐过时)。光鲜的房间很难替代一份公开说明，解释这些测量结果究竟意味着什么。

酒店软件试图(引导)客人养成更健康的作息。然而，它的界面说起话来仿佛(具有感知能力)，实际上仍是一个根据输入作出响应的(无知觉的)系统。称它的建议(富有智慧)，并不能证明其可靠性。检测运动的手环，如果没有更多背景信息，无法区分一个(懒散的)下午和必要的休息。

一位客人长途旅行后正(躺卧着)，另一位午饭后(昏昏欲睡)。第三位离开课程去看网球(锦标赛)，愉快地成了强制放松课程的(逃课者)。数据看板将三人都标记为活动不足。这是一种伪装成科学精确性的(欠考虑的)设计选择。

销售手册就没那么谨慎了。它把某项实验室指标的(初现的)变化与全面恢复青春联系起来，又把(伴随发生的)情绪改善当作定论。无论是(短暂的)感受，还是(转瞬即逝的)精力迸发，都不能证明长期益处。一张看似有说服力的图表，仍可能承载着站不住脚的推断。

这里有一种(耐人寻味的)讽刺。那些靠质疑供应商赚得财富的顾客，一旦供应商承诺青春，便变得格外轻信。昂贵西装之下，关于无限可能的(青春期的)幻想再次浮现。焕新生命成了(圣礼)，而对(超凡的)体验的追寻，削弱了平日索要收据的习惯。

有些服务并不需要这套神话。厨师可以制作(带涩味的)沙拉酱，园丁可以清除(有害的)虫患，理疗师可以提供(润肤的)乳液，都不必宣称能战胜时间。香草园里(浓烈的)气味，可能令一位客人愉悦，却让另一位觉得(令人厌恶)。偏好并不等于病理问题。

酒店主人的意图或许(善良)，但善意无法解决激励机制的问题。一家(奢华的)疗养酒店，从客人的反复依赖中赚到的钱，会比告诉客人不再需要任何服务更多。(有远见的)顾客会留下积蓄用于常规照护；(缺乏远虑的)顾客则会把积蓄花在追逐承诺上。与此同时，(贫困者)除了鼓舞人心的宣传，几乎得不到什么。

镇议会也有自己的(困境)。酒店创造就业，让此前(沉寂的)地方经济产生了(复苏的)信心。议员们对限制酒店感到(矛盾)。然而，他们的热情应当以宣传诚实为(前提条件)。创造就业并不意味着可以随意模糊酒店服务与医疗之间的界限。

一位(持异议的)投资者开始要求更清楚的信息披露。一群(奋起反抗的)前住客要求退款。他们的利益(存在分歧)，但对透明度的要求却(趋于一致)。管理层称这些抱怨(尖锐刺耳)；一位尤其(好斗的)发言人指责批评者怀有(恶意的)企图。这些形容词都没有回答任何问题。

当一名(记者)发表调查报道后，争论变得(动荡激烈)。一位调查(受访者)声称，自己曾受到购买额外疗程的压力。网上评论变得(恶毒)，匿名帖子将整个企业描述为(欺诈性的)。这种指控需要欺骗行为的证据。同样，把每位批评者都说成心怀恶意，也不能替代对有据可查的投诉作出回应。

议会既要避免(仓促的)禁令，也不能纵容拖延。(审慎的)应对方式，应当区分缺乏依据的广告与能够证实的不当行为。仅仅因为酒店大堂看起来令人安心，就为企业背书，是(不明智的)。监管应当对宣传主张采取(严格的)标准，同时避免把每个不确定的结果都当成过错。

这种平衡在政治上很棘手。(不肯妥协的)业主反对外部审查，(要求苛刻的)公众则希望立即获得确定答案。一项(宽松的)和解，在选举前可能显得(权宜有利)，选举后却可能证明是(不合宜的)。一位议员尖锐地指出：承诺增长的速度，超过了可用于调查承诺的预算。

就连书面材料也暴露了优先次序。设计师精心将手册中的客户赞言(缩进排版)，却把限制条件藏在浅色小字里。一个被认为(无礼的)、有关不良体验的问题，得到的却是措辞优美的答非所问。医疗主管提出用直白语言重写，董事长更喜欢一句安抚人心的话。坦诚是一项不太好推销的服务。

一家更好的阿斯特酒店，应当出售自己能够可信提供的东西：舒适、关怀，以及让日常好习惯更容易养成的环境。(始终存在的)挑战，是在顾客渴望奇迹时保持诚实。围绕这份朴素承诺打造一家(有韧性的)企业，或许不如许诺一个没有衰退的(遥远的)未来那么令人兴奋。但这也会让眼前的账单更容易说得过去。
text:
本批词根亮点：

• -escent 家族：nascent（新生）/renascent（复兴）/adolescent（青少年=正在成长）/obsolescent（正在过时）/evanescent（消逝）/convalescent（康复中）/iridescent（彩虹色），全都表示"正在变化中"的进行状态

• salient/resilient：都来自 salire（跳），salient=跳出来=显著，resilient=跳回来=有弹性

• sapient/Homo sapiens：来自拉丁语"品尝"（sapere），能品味知识=智慧，智人=智慧的人

• indolent：in（否定）+ dolor（痛苦），不感到痛苦=懒洋洋，condolences（哀悼）同根

• reticent：和 reticulate（网状的）同根，"被网住了嘴"=沉默寡言

• fluorescent：来自萤石（fluorspar）的荧光效应，fluor 来自 fluere（流动）

• plangent：来自 plangere（打击/哭泣），plaintiff（原告）同根

quiz.question: incogitant ______
quiz.explanation: 考虑不周的; 轻率的, 轻率的评论. His incogitant remark caused unnecessary offense. 他轻率的评论造成了不必要的冒犯。 | in->否定，cogit->思考（拉丁cogitare），incogitant->不加思考的=轻率的（cf. cogitate思考，cognitive认知，cogent有说服力的） || 文化联想：中文“话不过脑子就说出口”最适合帮助记忆 incogitant，可以说 **an incogitant remark — “Blurting out a criticism at a family dinner without thinking can become an incogitant remark that needlessly hurts someone.”**

quiz.question: concomitant _______
quiz.explanation: 伴随的; 同时发生的, 伴随的影响. The treatment has several concomitant effects. 这种治疗有几种伴随的影响。 | con->共同，comit->陪伴（拉丁comitari），concomitant->共同陪伴的=伴随的（cf. accompany陪伴，committee委员会，count伯爵） || 文化联想：中国人吃药时常会关注“伴随作用”，最适合帮助记忆 concomitant，可以说 **concomitant effects — “A treatment may bring concomitant effects that appear alongside its main therapeutic benefit.”**

quiz.question: precipitant ________
quiz.explanation: 沉淀剂; 仓促的, 添加沉淀剂. The precipitant addition caused the chemical reaction. 添加沉淀剂引起了化学反应。 | pre->向前，cipit->头（拉丁caput），precipitant->头朝前冲的=仓促/沉淀剂（cf. precipice悬崖，precipitation降水，capital首都） || 文化联想：中国中学化学实验里加入沉淀剂最适合帮助记忆 precipitant，可以说 **a precipitant reagent — “In a chemistry lab, a student may add a precipitant reagent to make dissolved ions form a visible solid.”**

quiz.question: unrepentant ______
quiz.explanation: 不悔改的; 顽固的, 不悔改的罪人. The unrepentant sinner refused to admit wrongdoing. 不悔改的罪人拒绝承认错误。 | un->否定，repent->悔恨（拉丁poenitere），unrepentant->不悔恨的（cf. penitent悔罪的，repent悔改，penal惩罚） || 文化联想：中文“死不悔改”最适合帮助记忆 unrepentant，可以说 **an unrepentant wrongdoer — “Someone who admits causing harm but still refuses to apologize may remain an unrepentant wrongdoer.”**

quiz.question: distant ________
quiz.explanation: 遥远的; 疏远的, 远房亲戚. She met a distant relative at the family reunion. 她在家庭聚会上遇见了一个远房亲戚。 | di->分开，stant->站立（拉丁stare），distant->站得很远的=遥远的（cf. distance距离，instant立即=站在当下，constant恒定） || 文化联想：春节大家族聚会偶尔会见到多年没见的远房亲戚，最适合帮助记忆 distant，可以说 **a distant relative — “At a large Spring Festival reunion, someone may suddenly meet a distant relative from another province.”**

quiz.question: constant ________
quiz.explanation: 恒定的; 不变的, 恒定速度. The object moved at constant velocity. 物体以恒定速度移动。 | con->一起，stant->站立，constant->始终站在那里=恒定的（cf. instant立即，distant遥远，stance立场，circumstance情况） || 文化联想：中国中学物理课学习匀速运动最适合帮助记忆 constant，可以说 **constant velocity — “A physics problem may describe a train moving at constant velocity along a straight track.”**

quiz.question: _____ extant
quiz.explanation: 现存的; 尚存的, 仍然现存的. The manuscripts are still extant in the library. 这些手稿仍然现存于图书馆中。 | ex->向外，stant->站立，extant->仍然站立着的=现存的（cf. exist存在，extinct灭绝=不再站立，constant恒定） || 文化联想：敦煌保存下来的古代文书最适合帮助记忆 extant，可以说 **an extant manuscript — “An extant manuscript from Dunhuang can preserve words written more than a thousand years ago.”**

quiz.question: ________ sextant
quiz.explanation: 六分仪, 航海六分仪. Sailors use a nautical sextant to navigate by stars. 水手使用航海六分仪通过星星导航。 | sext->六分之一（拉丁sextus->第六），sextant->测量六分之一圆弧的仪器=六分仪（cf. sextet六重奏，sixtieth第六十） || 文化联想：六分仪不是中国传统航海仪器，可用中国现代帆船课学习天文导航来记忆 sextant，可以说 **a nautical sextant — “A student in a sailing course may learn to use a nautical sextant to measure the angle of a celestial body above the horizon.”**

quiz.question: piquant ______
quiz.explanation: 辛辣的; 开胃的, 开胃的味道. The sauce has a piquant flavor that tingles the tongue. 这种酱汁有一种刺激舌头的开胃味道。 | piquer->刺（法语），piquant->有刺激性的=辛辣开胃的（cf. pique刺激，pike矛/梭鱼，picket尖桩/警戒线） || 文化联想：四川泡椒和酸辣小菜那种辛香开胃的味道最适合帮助记忆 piquant，可以说 **a piquant flavor — “Pickled chilies can give a Sichuan side dish a piquant flavor that is sharp, lively, and appetizing.”**

quiz.question: ______ truant
quiz.explanation: 逃学者, 逃学者. The school truant was caught by authorities. 逃学者被当局抓获。 | truant->游荡者（威尔士语truan->可怜的人），truant->逃学游荡的人（cf. play truant逃学，vagrant流浪者） || 文化联想：中文“逃学去网吧”这个熟悉画面最适合帮助记忆 truant，可以说 **a school truant — “A school truant may skip class and spend the afternoon somewhere the teachers do not expect to find him.”**

quiz.question: _______ savant
quiz.explanation: 学者; 专家, 博学的学者. The learned savant published groundbreaking research. 博学的学者发表了开创性的研究。 | savant->知道（法语savoir->知道），savant->博学者（cf. savvy精明，sage智者，idiot savant白痴学者） || 文化联想：中文“博学鸿儒”最适合帮助记忆 savant，可以说 **a learned savant — “A scholar who has mastered several fields and can discuss them deeply may be regarded as a learned savant.”**

quiz.question: flamboyant _____
quiz.explanation: 艳丽的; 炫耀的, 炫耀的风格. The artist is known for his flamboyant style. 这位艺术家以其炫耀的风格而闻名。 | flamb->火焰（法语flambe），flamboyant->像火焰一样炫耀的（cf. flame火焰，flambé火焰烹饪，flamingo红鹤=像火焰的鸟） || 文化联想：春晚舞台上极其抢眼的亮片服装最适合帮助记忆 flamboyant，可以说 **a flamboyant style — “A performer in a television gala may adopt a flamboyant style with brilliant colors, dramatic shapes, and sparkling decoration.”**

quiz.question: buoyant ______
quiz.explanation: 有浮力的; 活跃的, 活跃的市场. Investors are optimistic about the buoyant market. 投资者对活跃的市场持乐观态度。 | buoy->浮标（荷兰语boei），buoyant->像浮标一样上浮的=有浮力/活跃的（cf. buoy浮标，buoyancy浮力，float漂浮） || 文化联想：中文财经里“市场情绪活跃、行情向上”最适合帮助记忆 buoyant，可以说 **a buoyant market — “Strong earnings and rising confidence can keep the stock market buoyant for a period.”**

quiz.question: ______ clairvoyant
quiz.explanation: 有透视能力的; 有洞察力的, 有天赋的千里眼. The gifted clairvoyant predicted future events. 有天赋的千里眼预测了未来事件。 | clair->清楚（法语clair->clear），voyant->看（voir->看），clairvoyant->清晰地看=千里眼（cf. clear清楚，voyage旅程，voyeur偷窥者） || 文化联想：clairvoyant 是西方“千里眼/灵视者”概念，可用中国学生读西方神秘题材小说时来记忆，可以说 **a clairvoyant character — “In a fantasy novel, a clairvoyant character may claim to see events that ordinary people cannot perceive.”**

quiz.question: cognizant __ ____
quiz.explanation: 认识到的; 察觉到的, 察觉到事实. Everyone should be cognizant of fact before deciding. 每个人在决定前都应该察觉到事实。 | cogniz->知道（拉丁cognoscere），cognizant->已经知晓的=察觉的（cf. cognition认知，recognize认识，incognito匿名） || 文化联想：中文“心中有数”最适合帮助记忆 cognizant，可以说 **be cognizant of risk — “Before making a large investment, a careful buyer should be cognizant of risk rather than looking only at possible gains.”**

quiz.question: _______ bent
quiz.explanation: 倾向; 天赋, 天生的倾向. She has a natural bent for mathematics. 她对数学有天生的倾向。 | bent->弯曲的/倾向（bend的过去式），bent->天生的倾向（cf. bend弯曲，unbent坚定，bent on下定决心） || 文化联想：中文“天生对数学有感觉”最适合帮助记忆 bent，可以说 **a natural bent — “A child who enjoys puzzles and numbers from an early age may show a natural bent for mathematics.”**

quiz.question: recumbent ____
quiz.explanation: 斜躺的; 卧式的, 卧式自行车. He rides a recumbent bike for exercise. 他骑卧式自行车锻炼。 | re->回，cumb->躺（拉丁cumbere），recumbent->向后躺的=斜躺的（cf. incumbent现任的=肩负，succumb倒下，incubate孵化） || 文化联想：中国健身房里的卧式健身车最适合帮助记忆 recumbent，可以说 **a recumbent bike — “An older exerciser may choose a recumbent bike because the seat supports the back while pedaling.”**

quiz.question: adjacent ____
quiz.explanation: 邻近的; 毗连的, 相邻的房间. The conference is in the adjacent room. 会议在相邻的房间里。 | ad->朝向，jac->躺/靠近（拉丁jacere），adjacent->靠近的=邻近的（cf. adjoin毗连，abject沮丧=被抛在旁边，eject弹出） || 文化联想：中文“就在隔壁”最适合帮助记忆 adjacent，可以说 **an adjacent room — “During a conference, the speakers may wait in an adjacent room beside the main hall.”**

quiz.question: maleficent _____
quiz.explanation: 作恶的; 有害的, 邪恶的力量. The maleficent force threatened the kingdom. 邪恶的力量威胁着王国。 | male->坏，fic->做（拉丁），maleficent->做坏事的=作恶的（cf. magnificent宏大，beneficent行善，malefactor罪犯） || 文化联想：《西游记》里妖怪作恶的形象最适合帮助记忆 maleficent，可以说 **a maleficent force — “In a fantasy retelling of Journey to the West, an evil spirit may appear as a maleficent force threatening travelers.”**

quiz.question: magnificent _____
quiz.explanation: 壮丽的; 宏伟的, 壮丽的景色. The mountain offers a magnificent vista of the valley. 山上提供了山谷的壮丽景色。 | magni->大，fic->做，magnificent->做得很大=宏伟的（cf. magnify放大，magnanimous宽宏，maleficent作恶） || 文化联想：黄山云海和群峰最适合帮助记忆 magnificent，可以说 **a magnificent vista — “From a high viewpoint on Huangshan, visitors may see a magnificent vista of granite peaks rising above a sea of clouds.”**

quiz.question: reticent _____
quiz.explanation: 沉默寡言的; 含蓄的, 含蓄的微笑. She gave a reticent smile and said nothing. 她露出含蓄的微笑,什么也没说。 | reticent->沉默（拉丁reticere->保持沉默），reticent->少言寡语的（cf. taciturn沉默，reticulate网状的=被网住了嘴，同根） || 文化联想：中文“惜字如金、不太愿意多说”最适合帮助记忆 reticent，可以说 **a reticent manner — “A usually reticent engineer may listen through an entire meeting and speak only when there is something important to add.”**

quiz.question: nascent ________
quiz.explanation: 新生的; 初期的, 新兴产业. The nascent industry shows great potential. 新兴产业显示出巨大潜力。 | nasc->出生（拉丁nasci），nascent->正在出生的=新生的（cf. nature自然，native本土的，nation国家，Renaissance文艺复兴=再生） || 文化联想：中国人工智能和机器人创业刚刚兴起的领域最适合帮助记忆 nascent，可以说 **a nascent industry — “A new robotics cluster with only a handful of startups may still be a nascent industry.”**

quiz.question: renascent ________
quiz.explanation: 复兴的; 新生的, 复兴的产业. The renascent industry recovered from the recession. 复兴的产业从衰退中恢复过来。 | re->再，nasc->出生，renascent->再次出生的=复兴的（cf. nascent新生的，renaissance文艺复兴，natal出生的） || 文化联想：近年重新流行的汉服文化最适合帮助记忆 renascent，可以说 **a renascent tradition — “The growing popularity of Hanfu among young people can be described as part of a renascent interest in traditional dress.”**

quiz.question: ____ __ descent
quiz.explanation: 下降; 血统, 血统. He traced his line of descent back to royalty. 他追溯自己的血统到皇室。 | de->向下，scend->爬（拉丁scandere），descent->向下爬=下降/血统（cf. ascend上升，transcend超越，descend下降） || 文化联想：中国族谱一代一代往下追溯最适合帮助记忆 descent，可以说 **a line of descent — “A family genealogy may trace a line of descent from an ancestor through many later generations.”**

quiz.question: iridescent ________
quiz.explanation: 彩虹色的; 色彩斑斓的, 彩虹色的羽毛. The bird displayed iridescent feathers in the sunlight. 鸟在阳光下展示彩虹色的羽毛。 | Iris->彩虹女神（希腊），iridescent->像彩虹女神一样七彩的（cf. iris虹膜，iridium铱元素=彩虹色金属） || 文化联想：孔雀羽毛在阳光下变换蓝绿光泽最适合帮助记忆 iridescent，可以说 **iridescent feathers — “A peacock’s iridescent feathers can shift between blue, green, and bronze as the viewing angle changes.”**

quiz.question: quiescent _______
quiz.explanation: 静止的; 不活动的, 静止的火山. The quiescent volcano has not erupted in centuries. 静止的火山几个世纪没有爆发。 | quies->安静（拉丁），quiescent->处于安静状态的=静止的（cf. quiet安静，acquiesce默许，requiem安魂曲） || 文化联想：中国地理课里长期安静但仍需监测的火山最适合帮助记忆 quiescent，可以说 **a quiescent volcano — “A volcano may remain quiescent for a long period even though geologists continue to monitor it.”**

quiz.question: convalescent ____
quiz.explanation: 康复期的; 恢复健康的, 康复之家. He stayed at a convalescent home after surgery. 手术后他住在康复之家。 | con->加强，val->强壮（拉丁valere），escent->正在变化，convalescent->正在恢复强壮=康复期的（cf. valor勇气，valid有效，prevalent普遍） || 文化联想：中文“病后在家静养”最适合帮助记忆 convalescent，可以说 **a convalescent patient — “A convalescent patient may take short walks and gradually rebuild strength after leaving the hospital.”**

quiz.question: adolescent __________
quiz.explanation: 青春期的; 青少年, 青少年心理学. She specializes in adolescent psychology. 她专攻青少年心理学。 | ad->朝向，olesc->成长（拉丁adolescere），adolescent->正在成长的=青少年（cf. adult成人=已经成长，abolish废除=使停止成长） || 文化联想：中国中学生青春期心理变化最适合帮助记忆 adolescent，可以说 **adolescent psychology — “School counselors study adolescent psychology to better understand changes in mood, identity, friendship, and independence.”**

quiz.question: obsolescent ____
quiz.explanation: 即将过时的; 逐渐废弃的, 即将过时的技术. The obsolescent tech is being phased out. 即将过时的技术正在被淘汰。 | ob->对抗，solesc->成长，obsolescent->反向成长=正在过时的（cf. obsolete过时的，absolute绝对的，dissolve溶解） || 文化联想：中文“正在慢慢被淘汰的技术”最适合帮助记忆 obsolescent，可以说 **obsolescent technology — “An old payment system may become obsolescent as phones and newer digital platforms replace it.”**

quiz.question: evanescent ____
quiz.explanation: 短暂的; 逐渐消失的, 短暂的光辉. The evanescent glow faded at dusk. 短暂的光辉在黄昏时消退。 | e->向外，van->消失（拉丁evanescere），evanescent->消失于无形的=短暂的（cf. vanish消失，vanity虚荣，evaporate蒸发） || 文化联想：除夕烟花转瞬即逝的光最适合帮助记忆 evanescent，可以说 **an evanescent glow — “The evanescent glow of fireworks above a city can disappear only seconds after it lights the sky.”**

quiz.question: fluorescent _____
quiz.explanation: 荧光的, 荧光灯. The office uses fluorescent light for illumination. 办公室使用荧光灯照明。 | fluor->萤石（拉丁fluere->流）,escent->发出，fluorescent->发出荧光的（cf. fluoridate加氟，fluoride氟化物，fluid流体） || 文化联想：中国老教室里常见的荧光灯管最适合帮助记忆 fluorescent，可以说 **fluorescent light — “A classroom may once have been lit mainly by long fluorescent light tubes fixed to the ceiling.”**

quiz.question: __________ antecedent
quiz.explanation: 前情; 先例, 历史先例. The policy has a historical antecedent in earlier laws. 该政策在早期法律中有历史先例。 | ante->之前，ced->走，antecedent->走在前面的=先例/前情（cf. precede先于，cede让步，concede承认，precedent先例） || 文化联想：中文“凡事都有前因”最适合帮助记忆 antecedent，可以说 **a historical antecedent — “A historian may look for a historical antecedent that helps explain why a later reform took the form it did.”**

quiz.question: diffident _____
quiz.explanation: 缺乏自信的; 羞怯的, 羞怯的微笑. She gave a diffident smile when praised. 受到表扬时,她露出羞怯的微笑。 | dif->缺乏，fid->信任（拉丁fides），diffident->对自己缺乏信任=羞怯的（cf. confident自信，fidelity忠诚，fiancé未婚夫） || 文化联想：中文“有点怯生生、不太自信”最适合帮助记忆 diffident，可以说 **a diffident smile — “A student giving a first public presentation may begin with a diffident smile before gradually relaxing.”**

quiz.question: strident ____
quiz.explanation: 刺耳的; 尖锐的, 尖锐的语气. His strident tone made the argument worse. 他尖锐的语气使争论更糟。 | strid->发出刺耳声（拉丁stridere），strident->发出刺耳声的（cf. stride大步，strife争斗，obstruct阻碍） || 文化联想：中文“声音尖锐刺耳、咄咄逼人”最适合帮助记忆 strident，可以说 **a strident tone — “A debate becomes harder to resolve when both sides adopt a strident tone instead of listening.”**

quiz.question: resident _____
quiz.explanation: 居民; 常驻的, 外籍居民. As a resident alien, she has certain legal rights. 作为外籍居民,她享有某些法律权利。 | re->回，sid->坐（拉丁sedere），resident->持续坐在那里的=居民（cf. preside主持，reside居住，sediment沉淀物） || 文化联想：中文“城市居民”最适合帮助记忆 resident，可以说 **a longtime resident — “A longtime resident of Shanghai may know which streets become especially crowded during major holidays.”**

quiz.question: _________ dissident
quiz.explanation: 持不同政见者, 政治异见者. The political dissident was imprisoned for his views. 政治异见者因其观点被监禁。 | dis->不同，sid->坐（拉丁sedere），dissident->坐在不同地方的人=异见者（cf. president总统，resident居民，preside主持） || 文化联想：dissident 是政治语境中的“持不同政见者”，可用中国学生学习世界政治史时来记忆，可以说 **a political dissident — “In a world-history course, students may read about a political dissident who openly opposed an authoritarian government.”**

quiz.question: provident ____
quiz.explanation: 有远见的; 节俭的, 公积金. Workers contribute to a provident fund for retirement. 工人为退休缴纳公积金。 | pro->提前，vid->看（拉丁videre），provident->提前看到未来的=有远见的（cf. provide提供，providence天意，improvident无远见） || 文化联想：中国“住房公积金”是记忆 provident 的极好场景，可以说 **a housing provident fund — “Many Chinese employees contribute to a housing provident fund that can help with eligible housing expenses.”**

quiz.question: improvident ________
quiz.explanation: 无远见的; 浪费的, 无远见的支出. His improvident spending left him in debt. 他无远见的支出使他负债累累。 | im->否定，provident->有远见的，improvident->无远见的=浪费的（cf. provident有远见，provide提供，providence天意） || 文化联想：中文“寅吃卯粮、大手大脚”最适合帮助记忆 improvident，可以说 **improvident spending — “Repeatedly borrowing money for unnecessary luxuries is a form of improvident spending.”**

quiz.question: transcendent ______
quiz.explanation: 超越的; 卓越的, 超凡的美丽. The sunset displayed transcendent beauty. 日落展现了超凡的美丽。 | trans->越过，scend->爬，transcendent->超越一切的（cf. descend下降，ascend上升，transcendental超验的） || 文化联想：黄山日出穿过云海的景象最适合帮助记忆 transcendent，可以说 **transcendent beauty — “Sunrise above the sea of clouds on Huangshan can seem to possess transcendent beauty.”**

quiz.question: resplendent _____
quiz.explanation: 华丽的; 灿烂的, 华丽的长袍. The king wore resplendent robes for the ceremony. 国王在典礼上穿着华丽的长袍。 | re->加强，splend->闪耀（拉丁splendere），resplendent->极其闪耀的=华丽的（cf. splendid壮丽，splendor辉煌，refulgent灿烂） || 文化联想：唐风礼服金线刺绣、华光夺目的画面最适合帮助记忆 resplendent，可以说 **resplendent robes — “A performer dressed in Tang-inspired ceremonial clothing may appear in resplendent robes embroidered with gold.”**

quiz.question: pendent ______
quiz.explanation: 悬挂的; 下垂的, 吊灯. The pendent lights hung from the ceiling. 吊灯悬挂在天花板上。 | pend->悬挂（拉丁pendere），pendent->悬挂着的（cf. pendant吊坠，pendulum钟摆，depend依赖，suspend暂停） || 文化联想：春节街道上一排悬挂的红灯笼最适合帮助记忆 pendent，可以说 **pendent lanterns — “Rows of pendent red lanterns may hang above an old street during Spring Festival.”**

quiz.question: indent _________
quiz.explanation: 缩进; 订货, 缩进段落. Remember to indent paragraph in formal writing. 记得在正式写作中缩进段落。 | in->进入，dent->牙/缺口（拉丁dens），indent->在边缘切出缺口=缩进（cf. dental牙科，dent凹痕，indentation缩进） || 文化联想：中文文档排版里的“首行缩进”最适合帮助记忆 indent，可以说 **indent a paragraph — “When formatting a Chinese essay, a student may indent a paragraph at the beginning according to the required style.”**

quiz.question: ____ despondent
quiz.explanation: 沮丧的; 泄气的, 感到沮丧. She began to feel despondent after repeated failures. 经过反复失败后,她开始感到沮丧。 | de->向下，spond->承诺（拉丁spondere），despondent->承诺崩塌向下=沮丧的（cf. respond回应，correspond通信，sponsor赞助） || 文化联想：中文“垂头丧气”最适合帮助记忆 despondent，可以说 **feel despondent — “A student who fails an important exam after months of preparation may feel despondent for a while.”**

quiz.question: ______ respondent
quiz.explanation: 被告; 答复者, 调查对象. Each survey respondent answered 20 questions. 每个调查对象回答了20个问题。 | re->回，spond->承诺/回答，respondent->回答的人=调查对象/被告（cf. respond回应，responsible负责任，correspondent记者） || 文化联想：中国问卷调查里填写答案的人最适合帮助记忆 respondent，可以说 **a survey respondent — “A survey respondent may answer questions about commuting, housing, or consumer habits.”**

quiz.question: _______ correspondent
quiz.explanation: 记者; 通讯员, 外国记者. The foreign correspondent reported from the war zone. 外国记者从战区报道。 | cor->共同，respond->回答，correspondent->共同回应的人=通讯员（cf. respond回应，responsible负责，correspond对应） || 文化联想：新华社或其他媒体驻海外记者最适合帮助记忆 correspondent，可以说 **a foreign correspondent — “A foreign correspondent may report from another country and send stories back to readers at home.”**

quiz.question: ardent _________
quiz.explanation: 热情的; 热烈的, 热情的支持者. She is an ardent supporter of environmental causes. 她是环境事业的热情支持者。 | ard->燃烧（拉丁ardere），ardent->燃烧般热情的（cf. arson纵火，ardor热情，arduous艰难=需要燃烧力气的） || 文化联想：中国足球或篮球队的铁杆球迷最适合帮助记忆 ardent，可以说 **an ardent supporter — “An ardent supporter may follow the team for years and attend matches whenever possible.”**

quiz.question: impudent ______
quiz.explanation: 无礼的; 放肆的, 无礼的评论. His impudent remark shocked everyone present. 他无礼的评论震惊了在场的所有人。 | im->否定，pud->羞耻（拉丁pudere），impudent->没有羞耻的=无礼的（cf. pudeur羞耻，repudiate否认，pudendum羞处） || 文化联想：中文“没大没小、当面顶撞”最适合帮助记忆 impudent，可以说 **an impudent remark — “A student who mocks a teacher in front of the class may make an impudent remark.”**

quiz.question: prudent ________
quiz.explanation: 谨慎的; 明智的, 谨慎的投资者. The prudent investor diversified his portfolio. 谨慎的投资者分散了他的投资组合。 | prud->有远见（拉丁prudens->看得远），prudent->有远见的=谨慎的（cf. provide提供，jurisprudence法理学=看清法律） || 文化联想：中文“买房前把利率、现金流和风险都算清楚”最适合帮助记忆 prudent，可以说 **a prudent investor — “A prudent investor compares financing costs, risks, and expected returns before buying a property.”**

quiz.question: imprudent ________
quiz.explanation: 不谨慎的; 轻率的, 轻率的决定. The imprudent decision cost the company millions. 轻率的决定让公司损失了数百万。 | im->否定，prudent->谨慎，imprudent->不谨慎的（cf. prudent谨慎，jurisprudence法理学，improvident无远见） || 文化联想：中文“头脑一热就做决定”最适合帮助记忆 imprudent，可以说 **an imprudent decision — “Putting all of one’s savings into a speculative asset after hearing a rumor would be an imprudent decision.”**

quiz.question: ________ reagent
quiz.explanation: 试剂, 化学试剂. The lab ordered a new chemical reagent for testing. 实验室订购了新的化学试剂用于测试。 | re->回，ag->驱动（拉丁agere），reagent->在化学反应中驱动的物质=试剂（cf. react反应，reactant反应物，agent代理人） || 文化联想：中国中学化学实验室里的试剂瓶最适合帮助记忆 reagent，可以说 **a chemical reagent — “A student may add a chemical reagent drop by drop and observe whether the solution changes color.”**

quiz.question: _____ regent
quiz.explanation: 摄政者, 皇家摄政. The royal regent ruled until the prince came of age. 皇家摄政统治直到王子成年。 | reg->统治（拉丁regere），regent->代为统治的人=摄政（cf. regal皇家的，regulate调节，regime政权，region地区） || 文化联想：清初多尔衮担任摄政王的历史最适合帮助记忆 regent，可以说 **a royal regent — “Dorgon served as a powerful royal regent during the early reign of the young Shunzhi Emperor.”**

quiz.question: indigent ______
quiz.explanation: 贫困的; 贫穷的, 贫困的家庭. The charity helps indigent family with basic needs. 慈善机构帮助贫困家庭满足基本需求。 | indig->缺乏（拉丁indigere->需要），indigent->非常需要的=贫困的（cf. indigence贫困，indigent vs. indigenous本土的） || 文化联想：中文“家境贫寒、生活困难”最适合帮助记忆 indigent，可以说 **an indigent family — “A charity may provide food, school supplies, and medical help to an indigent family.”**

quiz.question: intransigent ______
quiz.explanation: 不妥协的; 固执的, 不妥协的立场. His intransigent stance prevented any compromise. 他不妥协的立场阻止了任何妥协。 | in->否定，trans->越过，ig->驱动，intransigent->不肯越步妥协的（cf. transact交易，transit过渡，transaction交易） || 文化联想：中文“寸步不让、死不妥协”最适合帮助记忆 intransigent，可以说 **an intransigent stance — “A negotiator who refuses every compromise may maintain an intransigent stance even when talks are close to collapse.”**

quiz.question: exigent _____________
quiz.explanation: 紧急的; 迫切的, 紧急情况. The law allows exceptions for exigent circumstances. 法律允许在紧急情况下例外。 | ex->向外，ig->驱动（拉丁exigere->要求），exigent->强烈要求的=紧迫的（cf. exact精确，examine检查，exiguous稀少） || 文化联想：地震抢险中刻不容缓的情况最适合帮助记忆 exigent，可以说 **exigent circumstances — “Rescuers may have to act immediately under exigent circumstances when people are trapped after an earthquake.”**

quiz.question: refulgent _____
quiz.explanation: 灿烂的; 辉煌的, 灿烂的光芒. The diamond sparkled with refulgent light. 钻石闪耀着灿烂的光芒。 | re->加强，fulg->闪光（拉丁fulgere），refulgent->极其闪耀的=灿烂的（cf. fulgent闪耀，effulgent光辉灿烂，cf. fulcrum支点） || 文化联想：晨光照在故宫琉璃瓦上闪耀的景象最适合帮助记忆 refulgent，可以说 **refulgent light — “Morning sun can cast refulgent light across the glazed roofs of the Forbidden City.”**

quiz.question: effulgent _____
quiz.explanation: 光辉灿烂的, 光辉灿烂的光. The sunrise cast effulgent light across the sky. 日出在天空中投射出光辉灿烂的光。 | ef->向外，fulg->闪光，effulgent->向外射出光芒的=光辉灿烂的（cf. refulgent灿烂，fulgent闪耀，fulgurite闪电石） || 文化联想：夜晚宫灯和金色装饰光华四射的画面最适合帮助记忆 effulgent，可以说 **effulgent light — “During a lantern festival, an ornate pavilion may seem wrapped in effulgent light.”**

quiz.question: plangent ____
quiz.explanation: 响亮的; 悲鸣的, 响亮的音调. The bell rang with a plangent tone. 钟声以响亮的音调响起。 | plang->打击/哭泣（拉丁plangere），plangent->撞击出的响亮悲鸣（cf. complain抱怨=大声哭诉，plaint哀诉，plaintiff原告） || 文化联想：二胡哀婉而有穿透力的声音最适合帮助记忆 plangent，可以说 **a plangent tone — “An erhu solo can take on a plangent tone that sounds both resonant and sorrowful.”**

quiz.question: stringent _____
quiz.explanation: 严格的; 严厉的, 严格的规则. The company enforces stringent rules for safety. 公司执行严格的安全规则。 | string->绑紧（拉丁stringere），stringent->绑得很紧的=严格的（cf. astringent收敛，constrict收缩，restrict限制） || 文化联想：高考考场严格的纪律最适合帮助记忆 stringent，可以说 **stringent rules — “A major national examination operates under stringent rules designed to protect fairness and security.”**

quiz.question: astringent _____
quiz.explanation: 收敛的; 涩的, 收敛性化妆水. Use an astringent toner to minimize pores. 使用收敛性化妆水来缩小毛孔。 | ad->朝向，string->绑紧，astringent->朝里绑紧=收敛的（cf. stringent严格，constrict收缩，restrict限制） || 文化联想：喝一口浓茶后嘴里发涩的感觉最适合帮助记忆 astringent，可以说 **an astringent taste — “Strongly brewed tea can leave an astringent taste that makes the mouth feel dry and puckered.”**

quiz.question: contingent _________
quiz.explanation: 可能发生的; 依情况而定的, 或有负债. The company disclosed contingent liability in its report. 公司在报告中披露了或有负债。 | con->共同，ting->触摸（拉丁tangere），contingent->共同接触=有可能接触到的=依情而定的（cf. contagious传染，tangible可触，contact接触） || 文化联想：中国企业财报里担保责任等“或有负债”最适合帮助记忆 contingent，可以说 **a contingent liability — “A company guarantee may create a contingent liability that becomes real only if a specified event occurs.”**

quiz.question: pungent _____
quiz.explanation: 刺激的; 辛辣的, 刺鼻的气味. The cheese has a pungent smell that is quite strong. 奶酪有一种相当浓烈的刺鼻气味。 | pung->刺（拉丁pungere），pungent->像针刺一样刺激的（cf. puncture刺穿，compunction内疚，poignant辛酸，expunge删除） || 文化联想：臭豆腐强烈的气味最适合帮助记忆 pungent，可以说 **a pungent smell — “Freshly fried stinky tofu can have a pungent smell that reaches people long before they reach the stall.”**

quiz.question: cogent ________
quiz.explanation: 有说服力的; 令人信服的, 有说服力的论点. The lawyer presented a cogent argument to the jury. 律师向陪审团提出了有说服力的论点。 | cog->驱动（拉丁cogere->强迫），cogent->强迫人信服的=有说服力的（cf. cogitate思考，coerce强迫，incognito匿名） || 文化联想：中文“有理有据、让人信服”最适合帮助记忆 cogent，可以说 **a cogent argument — “An explanation supported by clear evidence and sound logic can become a cogent argument.”**

quiz.question: divergent _____
quiz.explanation: 分歧的; 不同的, 分歧的观点. The committee members held divergent views on the issue. 委员会成员对这个问题持有分歧的观点。 | di->分开，verg->转向（拉丁vergere），divergent->朝两个方向转=分歧的（cf. converge汇聚，verge边缘，subvert颠覆） || 文化联想：中文“各有各的看法、意见分叉”最适合帮助记忆 divergent，可以说 **divergent views — “A family discussing whether to sell an old house may develop divergent views about money, memory, and practicality.”**

quiz.question: convergent _________
quiz.explanation: 趋同的; 会聚的, 趋同进化. Scientists study convergent evolution in different species. 科学家研究不同物种的趋同进化。 | con->共同，verg->转向，convergent->朝同一方向转=趋同的（cf. divergent分歧，verge接近，subvert颠覆） || 文化联想：中国生物课学习不同生物独立演化出相似特征最适合帮助记忆 convergent，可以说 **convergent evolution — “A biology student may learn that similar environmental pressures can produce convergent evolution in unrelated species.”**

quiz.question: insurgent ______
quiz.explanation: 叛乱的; 起义者, 叛乱军队. The insurgent forces attacked the capital. 叛乱军队攻击了首都。 | in->向上，surg->升起（拉丁surgere），insurgent->起身反抗的=叛乱的（cf. surge涌现，insurrection叛乱，resurrect复活） || 文化联想：insurgent 是军事政治语境里的“叛乱武装”，可用中国学生学习世界近现代史来记忆，可以说 **insurgent forces — “In a modern-history course, students may read about insurgent forces fighting a central government.”**

quiz.question: ______ proficient
quiz.explanation: 熟练的; 精通的, 非常熟练的. She is highly proficient in three languages. 她精通三种语言。 | pro->向前，fic->做（拉丁），proficient->向前做到位=熟练的（cf. efficient有效，sufficient足够，deficient不足，proficiency熟练） || 文化联想：中文“熟能生巧、做得很在行”最适合帮助记忆 proficient，可以说 **proficient in calligraphy — “Years of disciplined brush practice can make a student proficient in calligraphy.”**

quiz.question: omniscient ________
quiz.explanation: 全知的, 全知叙述者. The novel uses an omniscient narrator perspective. 小说使用全知叙述者视角。 | omni->全部，sci->知道（拉丁scire），omniscient->知道一切的=全知的（cf. science科学，conscience良心，conscious有意识的） || 文化联想：中国章回小说里作者知道所有人物心事的叙事方式最适合帮助记忆 omniscient，可以说 **an omniscient narrator — “A traditional-style novel may use an omniscient narrator who can reveal what several characters are thinking at once.”**

quiz.question: ___________ expedient
quiz.explanation: 权宜的; 方便的, 政治上权宜的. The decision was politically expedient but morally wrong. 这个决定在政治上是权宜之计,但在道德上是错误的。 | ex->向外，ped->脚，expedient->解放脚=方便/权宜的（cf. expedite加快，impede阻碍，pedestrian行人，expedition探险） || 文化联想：中文“权宜之计”最适合帮助记忆 expedient，可以说 **a politically expedient compromise — “A leader may accept a politically expedient compromise because it solves an immediate problem, even if it is not ideal.”**

quiz.question: inexpedient ____
quiz.explanation: 不适宜的; 不明智的, 不明智的举动. Raising taxes now would be an inexpedient move. 现在增税将是不明智的举动。 | in->否定，expedient->权宜的，inexpedient->不权宜/不明智的（cf. expedient权宜，expedite加快，impede阻碍） || 文化联想：中文“这么做不合时宜、得不偿失”最适合帮助记忆 inexpedient，可以说 **an inexpedient move — “Raising prices sharply during a public-relations crisis would be an inexpedient move.”**

quiz.question: ______ ingredient
quiz.explanation: 成分; 要素, 活性成分. The active ingredient treats the infection effectively. 活性成分有效治疗感染。 | in->进入，gredi->走（拉丁），ingredient->走进去的东西=成分（cf. progress进步，congress会议，degrade降级，grade等级） || 文化联想：中国火锅里每一样食材都是 ingredient，可以说 **a hotpot ingredient — “Lotus root, tofu, mushrooms, and sliced meat can each be a hotpot ingredient.”**

quiz.question: salient _______
quiz.explanation: 显著的; 突出的, 显著特征. The report highlights the salient feature of the proposal. 报告强调了提案的显著特征。 | sali->跳（拉丁salire），salient->跳出来的=显著的（cf. sally突击，result结果，exult欢跳，somersault翻筋斗） || 文化联想：中文“最突出的重点、一眼就跳出来”最适合帮助记忆 salient，可以说 **a salient feature — “The most salient feature of a traditional courtyard house may be the central open courtyard around which the rooms are arranged.”**

quiz.question: resilient _______
quiz.explanation: 有弹性的; 有韧性的, 有韧性的经济. The resilient economy recovered quickly from the crisis. 有韧性的经济从危机中迅速恢复。 | re->回，sili->跳，resilient->跳回来的=有弹性的（cf. salient显著，exult欢跳，insult侮辱=跳到脸上，result结果） || 文化联想：中文“百折不挠、受打击后还能弹回来”最适合帮助记忆 resilient，可以说 **a resilient economy — “An economy that recovers quickly after a severe shock can be described as resilient—很像‘百折不挠.’”**

quiz.question: ____ emollient
quiz.explanation: 润肤的; 缓和的, 皮肤润肤剂. Apply skin emollient to dry areas daily. 每天在干燥区域涂抹皮肤润肤剂。 | e->使，moll->软（拉丁mollis），emollient->使皮肤软化的=润肤的（cf. mollify安抚，mollusk软体动物，molten熔融） || 文化联想：北京冬天空气干燥时常用润肤霜最适合帮助记忆 emollient，可以说 **an emollient cream — “In a dry northern winter, an emollient cream can help soften and protect cracked skin.”**

quiz.question: lenient ________
quiz.explanation: 宽大的; 仁慈的, 宽大的判决. The judge gave a lenient sentence to the first offender. 法官对初犯给予了宽大的判决。 | len->柔和（拉丁lenis->温和），lenient->温和宽容的（cf. relent软化，relentless不停息，lenity宽大） || 文化联想：中文法律语境里的“从轻判决”最适合帮助记忆 lenient，可以说 **a lenient sentence — “A judge may impose a lenient sentence on a first-time offender when the law and circumstances justify mercy.”**

quiz.question: sapient ______
quiz.explanation: 智慧的; 聪明的, 明智的选择. Hiring her proved to be a sapient choice. 雇用她被证明是明智的选择。 | sap->尝味/品鉴（拉丁sapere->品尝/智慧），sapient->有智慧的（cf. Homo sapiens智人，savor品味，savant学者，sage智者） || 文化联想：中文“三思而后行”最适合帮助记忆 sapient，可以说 **a sapient choice — “Choosing the safer long-term option after carefully weighing the evidence can be a sapient choice.”**

quiz.question: ___ recipient
quiz.explanation: 接受者; 受益人, 援助接受者. The aid recipient thanked the donors for their generosity. 援助接受者感谢捐赠者的慷慨。 | re->回，cip->抓取（拉丁capere），recipient->接过来的人=接受者（cf. receive接收，perceive感知，reception接待） || 文化联想：中国奖学金获得者最适合帮助记忆 recipient，可以说 **a scholarship recipient — “A scholarship recipient may use the award to cover tuition, books, and living expenses.”**

quiz.question: incipient _____
quiz.explanation: 初期的; 开始的, 初期阶段. The disease was caught at an incipient stage. 疾病在初期阶段被发现。 | in->进入，cip->抓取/开始，incipient->刚开始抓住的=初期的（cf. inception开始，receive接收，concept概念） || 文化联想：中文“防微杜渐、在苗头刚出现时就处理”最适合帮助记忆 incipient，可以说 **an incipient problem — “Fixing an incipient problem before it spreads is often easier than waiting until the damage becomes obvious.”**

quiz.question: oriental ___
quiz.explanation: 东方的, 东方地毯. The oriental rug added elegance to the room. 东方地毯为房间增添了优雅。 | orient->东方（拉丁oriens->日出的方向），oriental->东方的（cf. orient方向，orientation定向，disoriented迷失方向） || 文化联想：oriental 更适合用于物品或传统分类而不宜用来称呼人，可用中国学生学习英语用法时记忆，可以说 **an oriental rug — “An English learner may encounter the traditional term oriental rug for certain carpets while avoiding oriental as a label for people.”**

quiz.question: nutrient ______
quiz.explanation: 营养物; 营养的, 营养摄入. Monitor your daily nutrient intake for better health. 监测你的每日营养摄入以获得更好的健康。 | nutri->滋养（拉丁nutrire），nutrient->提供滋养的物质（cf. nutrition营养，nurse护士，nourish滋养） || 文化联想：中国家庭讲究荤素搭配来保证营养摄入，最适合帮助记忆 nutrient，可以说 **nutrient intake — “A balanced meal with vegetables, grains, protein, and fruit can improve daily nutrient intake.”**

quiz.question: transient _____
quiz.explanation: 短暂的; 临时的, 临时客人. The hotel caters to transient guest passing through. 酒店为路过的临时客人提供服务。 | trans->穿越，ient->走，transient->穿越而过的=短暂的（cf. transit过境，transcend超越，transitory短暂的） || 文化联想：中文“只是匆匆过客”最适合帮助记忆 transient，可以说 **a transient visitor — “A traveler who stays in a city for only one night is a transient visitor rather than a long-term resident.”**

quiz.question: sentient _____
quiz.explanation: 有感觉的; 有知觉的, 有知觉的生命. All sentient being deserve compassion and respect. 所有有知觉的生命都值得同情和尊重。 | sent->感觉（拉丁sentire），sentient->有感觉能力的（cf. sense感觉，sensitive敏感，sentiment情感，consent同意） || 文化联想：佛教里“有情众生”的说法最适合帮助记忆 sentient，可以说 **sentient beings — “In Buddhist vocabulary, ‘有情众生’ is often translated as sentient beings capable of feeling and experience.”**

quiz.question: insentient ______
quiz.explanation: 无感觉的; 无生命的, 无生命的物质. Rocks are insentient matter without consciousness. 岩石是无意识的无生命物质。 | in->否定，sentient->有感觉的，insentient->无感觉的（cf. sentient有知觉，sensory感觉的，insensible无感觉） || 文化联想：中文“无知觉的石头”最适合帮助记忆 insentient，可以说 **insentient matter — “A stone may be described as insentient matter because it has no capacity for sensation or awareness.”**

quiz.question: ambivalent ________
quiz.explanation: 矛盾的; 模棱两可的, 矛盾的态度. She has an ambivalent attitude toward the proposal. 她对这个提案持有矛盾的态度。 | ambi->两者，val->力量/价值，ambivalent->对两者都有感情=矛盾的（cf. ambiguous模棱两可，ambidextrous两手灵，valor勇气） || 文化联想：中文“既期待又担心、心里很矛盾”最适合帮助记忆 ambivalent，可以说 **an ambivalent attitude — “A family moving to a new city may have an ambivalent attitude, excited by new opportunities but sad to leave familiar surroundings.”**

quiz.question: ____________ equivalent
quiz.explanation: 等价的; 相等的, 数学等式. The two expressions are mathematical equivalent. 这两个表达式在数学上是等价的。 | equ->相等，val->价值，equivalent->价值相等的（cf. equal平等，equate等同，equity公平，equinox春秋分） || 文化联想：中国中学数学里把两个式子化成等价形式最适合帮助记忆 equivalent，可以说 **an equivalent expression — “A student may simplify an equation and replace one expression with an equivalent expression that has the same value.”**

quiz.question: pestilent _______
quiz.explanation: 瘟疫的; 有害的, 瘟疫性疾病. The pestilent disease spread rapidly through the city. 瘟疫性疾病在城市中迅速传播。 | pest->瘟疫（拉丁pestis），pestilent->像瘟疫一样有害的（cf. pest害虫，pesticide杀虫剂，pestilence瘟疫） || 文化联想：中国历史课讨论古代瘟疫时最适合帮助记忆 pestilent，可以说 **a pestilent disease — “In a historical account, a pestilent disease may spread rapidly through crowded towns with little effective treatment.”**

quiz.question: repellent ____
quiz.explanation: 令人厌恶的; 防护的, 令人厌恶的气味. The garbage gave off a repellent odor. 垃圾散发出令人厌恶的气味。 | re->回，pell->推（拉丁pellere），repellent->推开的=令人厌恶的（cf. propel推进，expel驱逐，compel强迫，impel推动） || 文化联想：夏天垃圾桶散发让人避之不及的气味最适合帮助记忆 repellent，可以说 **a repellent odor — “Food waste left in summer heat can produce a repellent odor that makes people step away immediately.”**

quiz.question: redolent __ _____
quiz.explanation: 芳香的; 使人想起的, 散发玫瑰香气. The garden air was redolent of roses in bloom. 花园的空气散发着盛开玫瑰的香气。 | re->回，dol->气味（拉丁olere->散发气味），redolent->回散着气味的=芳香的（cf. odor气味，deodorant除臭剂，olfaction嗅觉） || 文化联想：桂花季满院都是香气最适合帮助记忆 redolent，可以说 **redolent of osmanthus — “An autumn courtyard in Hangzhou may be redolent of osmanthus when the tiny flowers are in bloom.”**

quiz.question: indolent _________
quiz.explanation: 懒惰的; 无痛的, 懒散的生活方式. His indolent lifestyle led to health problems. 他懒散的生活方式导致了健康问题。 | in->否定，dol->痛苦（拉丁dolere），indolent->不感到痛苦的=慵懒无痛的（cf. condolences哀悼，dolor痛苦，doleful悲哀） || 文化联想：中文“好吃懒做”最适合帮助记忆 indolent，可以说 **an indolent lifestyle — “Someone who avoids work, exercise, and responsibility may fall into an indolent lifestyle.”**

quiz.question: somnolent _____
quiz.explanation: 困倦的; 催眠的, 困倦状态. The medication left him in a somnolent state. 药物使他处于困倦状态。 | somn->睡眠（拉丁somnus），somnolent->充满睡意的（cf. somnambulism梦游，insomnia失眠，dormitory宿舍） || 文化联想：中文“午饭后昏昏欲睡”最适合帮助记忆 somnolent，可以说 **a somnolent state — “After a heavy lunch on a warm afternoon, an office worker may slip into a somnolent state.”**

quiz.question: benevolent ______
quiz.explanation: 仁慈的; 善意的, 仁慈的领导者. The benevolent leader cared deeply for his people. 仁慈的领导者深切关心他的人民。 | bene->好，vol->意愿（拉丁velle），benevolent->有好意愿的=仁慈的（cf. volunteer自愿者，malevolent恶意，volition意志） || 文化联想：孟子所说的“仁政”可以帮助记忆 benevolent，可以说 **a benevolent ruler — “In traditional political thought, a benevolent ruler is expected to care about the welfare of ordinary people.”**

quiz.question: turbulent _____
quiz.explanation: 动荡的; 骚乱的, 动荡的时期. The nation survived turbulent times of war and upheaval. 国家在战争和动荡的动荡时期幸存下来。 | turb->搅乱（拉丁turbare），turbulent->搅乱的=动荡的（cf. disturb打扰，perturb使不安，turbine涡轮=被搅动） || 文化联想：中文“风云动荡的年代”最适合帮助记忆 turbulent，可以说 **turbulent times — “A family memoir may describe turbulent times marked by war, migration, and rapid political change.”**

quiz.question: truculent ____
quiz.explanation: 好斗的; 残暴的, 好斗的语气. His truculent tone escalated the disagreement. 他好斗的语气使分歧升级。 | truc->凶残（拉丁trux->凶猛），truculent->凶残好斗的（cf. truculent vs. pugnacious两者都是好斗，truculent更残暴） || 文化联想：中文“横眉冷对、语气蛮横好斗”最适合帮助记忆 truculent，可以说 **a truculent tone — “A speaker who answers every question with hostility may adopt a truculent tone that makes discussion difficult.”**

quiz.question: fraudulent ______
quiz.explanation: 欺诈的; 欺骗性的, 欺诈计划. Investigators uncovered a fraudulent scheme to steal money. 调查人员揭露了一个欺诈计划来窃取金钱。 | fraud->欺骗（拉丁fraus），fraudulent->充满欺骗的（cf. fraud欺诈，defraud诈骗，fraudster诈骗犯） || 文化联想：中国常见的电信诈骗最适合帮助记忆 fraudulent，可以说 **a fraudulent scheme — “A caller pretending to be a police officer and demanding an urgent transfer may be running a fraudulent scheme.”**

quiz.question: opulent _______
quiz.explanation: 富裕的; 豪华的, 豪华的豪宅. The billionaire lived in an opulent mansion. 亿万富翁住在豪华的豪宅里。 | op->财富（拉丁opes->财富），opulent->拥有大量财富的=豪华的（cf. opulence富裕，inoperable无法操作，operation操作） || 文化联想：晋商大院里豪华宽阔的宅邸最适合帮助记忆 opulent，可以说 **an opulent mansion — “A wealthy merchant family in an old historical drama may live in an opulent mansion with carved wood, courtyards, and elaborate furnishings.”**

quiz.question: corpulent ____
quiz.explanation: 肥胖的, 肥胖的身体. His corpulent body made movement difficult. 他肥胖的身体使行动困难。 | corp->身体（拉丁corpus），corpulent->身体过于庞大的=肥胖的（cf. corpus文集，corpse尸体，incorporate并入，corporal肉体的） || 文化联想：古典小说里常把富商写成身材肥胖的人物，最适合帮助记忆 corpulent，可以说 **a corpulent merchant — “An old-fashioned novel may portray a prosperous, corpulent merchant seated comfortably behind a shop counter.”**

quiz.question: virulent ______
quiz.explanation: 剧毒的; 恶毒的, 剧毒的病毒株. Scientists study the virulent strain of the disease. 科学家研究该疾病的剧毒病毒株。 | vir->毒（拉丁virus），virulent->毒性强烈的（cf. virus病毒，virtual实际上，virtue美德=力量，virile男性的） || 文化联想：中国医院传染病科讨论毒力很强的病原株最适合帮助记忆 virulent，可以说 **a virulent strain — “Doctors may worry when a virulent strain causes more severe disease and spreads rapidly.”**

quiz.question: __ _ predicament
quiz.explanation: 困境; 窘境, 处于困境. She found herself in a predicament with no easy solution. 她发现自己处于没有简单解决方案的困境中。 | predic->宣告（拉丁praedicare），predicament->被宣判的处境=困境（cf. predict预言，predicate谓语，preach布道） || 文化联想：中文“进退两难”最适合帮助记忆 predicament，可以说 **be in a predicament — “A family that must choose between an unaffordable repair and an expensive move may be in a predicament—真正‘进退两难.’”**

quiz.question: ____ filament
quiz.explanation: 细丝; 灯丝, 细丝. The spider spun a fine filament web. 蜘蛛编织了一张细丝网。 | filum->线（拉丁），filament->极细的线=细丝/灯丝（cf. file文件=线状排列，profile轮廓线，filiform线状） || 文化联想：中国3D打印机把一卷细丝送进喷头最适合帮助记忆 filament，可以说 **a plastic filament — “A desktop 3D printer feeds a plastic filament into a heated nozzle to build an object layer by layer.”**

quiz.question: ______ tournament
quiz.explanation: 锦标赛; 联赛, 网球锦标赛. She competed in the tennis tournament last weekend. 她上周末参加了网球锦标赛。 | tourner->转（法语），tournament->骑士绕圈比武=锦标赛（cf. tour旅游，tourniquet止血带，detour绕道，contour轮廓） || 文化联想：中国乒乓球比赛最适合帮助记忆 tournament，可以说 **a table-tennis tournament — “Young athletes from several provinces may compete in a national table-tennis tournament.”**

quiz.question: ____ sacrament
quiz.explanation: 圣礼; 圣事, 神圣的圣礼. The priest administered the holy sacrament. 牧师主持了神圣的圣礼。 | sacr->神圣（拉丁sacer），sacrament->神圣的仪式=圣礼（cf. sacred神圣，sacrifice牺牲，sacrilege渎神，consecrate奉献） || 文化联想：sacrament 是基督教“圣礼”，可用中国教堂礼拜场景来记忆，可以说 **a holy sacrament — “In a Christian church in China, believers may participate in a holy sacrament according to their denomination’s tradition.”**
